values.application_temp: Not below 4 °C (40 °F), not on frozen substrate or if freezing expected during the approx. 24 h curing period
values.packaging: 22.7 kg (50 lb) bags or 25 kg (55 lb) pails

pot_life.label: mix only what can be used within 20 min (no temperature stated)

entries.notes: Same product as the existing rc/IM Penetron entry. Per-metre consumption implied ≈ 1.5 kg/m (22.7 kg / 15.2 m, derived, not printed).

entries.type: Pre-blended, fibre-reinforced high-performance crystalline repair grout for waterproof concrete and masonry repairs (cracks, spalls, honeycombs)

values.thickness: No layer limit printed; repairs or overlays thicker than 25 mm: extend with clean graded pea gravel (max. size ≤ 1/3 of repair depth; approx. 4 parts powder : 2 parts gravel : up to 1 part water)
values.consumption: Yield: 25 kg pail approx. 13 l; 5 kg pail approx. 2.6 l
values.water: Concrete/leak repair: 4.5 parts powder to 1 part water by volume (parge coat 4 : 1; bonding slurry 3 : 1)
values.pot_life: Working time 30 minutes (20 °C, 50 % RH); hardening 1–1.5 h
values.packaging: 25 kg (55 lb) and 5 kg (11 lb) pails
values.shelf_life: At least 3 years for unopened pails stored in a dry, enclosed area

entries.notes: Kryton's only repair mortar (also entered at cr/IM and in the existing rc/IM comparison); it is a crystalline repair grout, not an EN 1504-3 R4 PCC mortar — no R-class, E-modulus or chloride content printed. Hydrostatic head resistance 140 m (USACE CRD-C48). Yield 13 l per 25 kg implies ≈ 1.9 kg/m² per mm (derived, not printed).

entries.reason: No polyurethane injection resins in the Kryton range (kryton.com products: admixtures, surface-applied, joints & details, concrete repair)
No injection foams; Kryton stops active leaks with Krystol Plug (existing rc/F20 entry)
No epoxy injection resins in the Kryton range
No fine smoothing / resurfacing mortar; Krystol Repair Grout has a parge-coat mix but no thin-layer data (entered at cr/BIS540 and cr/IM)
No reinforcement corrosion-protection / bond-coat product (EN 1504-7) in the Kryton range
No liquid crystalline admixture: KIM is a grey powder (TDS V2023-09); KIM BioGard, Hard-Cem, Con-Fume (silica fume) and KMA are also powders
No non-crystalline rigid mineral sealing slurry; Kryton's slurry is the crystalline Krystol T1 (existing rc/IC entry)
No flexible two-component cementitious waterproofing slurry in the Kryton range
No thick-layer flexible cementitious waterproofing in the Kryton range
No OS 5b / EN 1504-2 crack-bridging surface protection system in the Kryton range
No epoxy primers or binders in the Kryton range
No epoxy barrier primers in the Kryton range
No epoxy floor coatings in the Kryton range
No water-emulsified epoxy sealers in the Kryton range (Hydrostop Sealer is a water-based silane/siloxane penetrating sealer, a different category)
No epoxy chemical-resistant coatings in the Kryton range
No joint sealants in the Kryton range (Krytonite is a swelling waterstop)

No epoxy injection resin: the Penetron Group range has only PENETRON INJECT (crystalline two-component cementitious injection grout); Penetron Hellas' injection category lists only PU foam/resin and cement grouts
No EN 1504-7 corrosion-protection / bond-coat mortar; PENETRON ACRYLIC BONDCRETE (Penetron Hellas) is an acrylic bonding emulsion, a different category
No thick-layer (bitumen-free) flexible cementitious waterproofing
No OS 5b / EN 1062-7 classified crack-bridging surface protection; the elastic SEAL COAT system (entered at wp/AQ2K) has no published crack-bridging class

No Penetron-named epoxy barrier primer for damp substrates; PENEPOX W (Penetron Hellas) is a water-based adhesion primer for substrates ≤ 7 % moisture, and the 'EP' range sold by Penetron Hellas is not Penetron-branded
No Penetron-branded epoxy floor coating; Penetron Hellas resells an unbranded 'EP' range (e.g. EP 216 UNIVERSAL), not treated as a Penetron product
No Penetron-branded water-emulsified epoxy floor sealer; PENEPOX W (Penetron Hellas) is a water-based epoxy adhesion primer, not a floor sealer
No Penetron-branded chemically resistant epoxy coating; Penetron Hellas' EP 280/282 WHG are unbranded resale products
No Penetron-branded joint sealant; Penetron Hellas resells U-SEAL / SiMP SEAL sealants under those names (not Penetron-branded)
